title: The Land of Oz by L. Frank Baum - Illustrated by John R. Neill - Del Rey Fantasy
descriptionText: The product is a softcover edition of "The Land of Oz" by L. Frank Baum, illustrated by John R. Neill and published by Ballantine Books. This fantasy novel is a part of the literature and fiction genre, featuring characters from the Wizard of Oz series. Originating from the United States, this collectible item is perfect for fans of the beloved fantasy world created by Baum.
